title: Ball moved while looking for it
question: If you accidentally move your ball while searching for it in the rough, what should you do according to the rules?

choices.text: Play the ball from where it ends up
Replace the ball and take a one-stroke penalty
Drop a new ball and play on

explanation: If your ball is accidentally moved while searching for it, you must put it back without penalty.
imagePrompt: A teenage left-handed boy in the rough searching for his ball among long grass, close-up on him noticing the ball has moved.
imageAlt: Teenage left-handed boy in the rough searching for his golf ball, noticing it has been accidentally moved.
